name: x.md
description: Read-only HTTP API that renders public X (Twitter) posts, threads, profiles, search results, followers, and following as Markdown or JSON.

name: Start reading X
description: The one-request quick start: swap the host on any public x.com URL and read the post as Markdown.

name: Posts and threads
description: GET /{handle}/status/{id}: thread, conversation context, reply ordering, user info, and cache bypass.

name: Search X
description: GET /search?q=…: the latest, top, photos, videos, and users feeds, and which need configured sessions.

name: Profiles and connections
description: GET /{handle}, /followers, and /following, and what is filtered out of a profile timeline.

name: Import a post history
description: GET /{handle}/posts: an account's whole history in one request, replies included, raw JSON or NDJSON, walked in parallel and archived per account.

name: Pagination
description: Cursor versus page pagination, exact pages up to 100, offset cursors, and why cursors have no ceiling.

name: Response formats
description: Compact Markdown, ?full=true, ?format=obsidian, and the JSON body fields.

name: Errors, limits, and caching
description: Status codes, Retry-After, X-Source, X-Cache, and the one-hour cache.

name: MCP server
description: Connect an agent to x.md over the Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP transport, no key required.

name: Error catalogue
description: Every machine-readable error code x.md can return, what it means, and how to recover from it.

name: Versioning and deprecation
description: What /api/v1 promises, how a change is announced, and how long a route keeps working after it is deprecated.

name: Agent skill
description: Install browse-x, its CLI options, and the exit codes an agent should branch on.

name: Self-hosting
description: Environment variables, providers, and deploying your own x.md instance.
